info.description:
The Flexera One IT Asset Management APIs provide RESTful APIs that allow users to export and manage IT asset management data programmatically. This capability is crucial for integrating with other systems, generating detailed reports, and efficiently managing software licenses by dynamically allocating and deallocating them as required.
By utilizing these APIs, organizations gain enhanced control over their IT assets and can streamline their asset management processes significantly. They can automate workflows for application requests, making it easier to allocate or deallocate licenses promptly. This automation not only improves operational efficiency but also ensures compliance with licensing agreements and optimizes resource utilization across the IT infrastructure.  

In essence, the Flexera One IT Asset Management APIs empower organizations to leverage data-driven insights and automation to enhance overall IT management practices and achieve greater operational efficiency.

The API is available at the following endpoints, based on the location (Zone) of your organization:
| Zone        | Base URL    |
| ----------- | ----------- |
| NAM         | https://api.flexera.com/fnms/ |
| EU          | https://api.flexera.eu/fnms/ |
| APAC        | https://api.flexera.au/fnms/ |


## Authentication and Authorization
Requests made to the API must be authenticated using an access token obtained from Flexera IAM using your
region appropriate domain suffix, or Top Level Domain.
The API endpoints below list the privileges required to call the endpoints.

Flexera One IT Asset Management (ITAM) Asset API offers detailed information about Assets managed within Flexera One ITAM. Users can filter to retrieve relevant assets by type, status, or location. The API provides asset details data along with inventory date, enterprise group (location, cost center, department), assigned and logged-in user, and purchase details. Overall, the Flexera One ITAM Asset API serves as a crucial tool for maintaining accurate records of IT assets, supporting efficient IT asset management processes, and enabling organizations to achieve greater control and compliance in managing their IT resources.
**Benefits and Practical Applications:** * **Integration Capabilities:** The API supports seamless integration with other systems and tools within the organization's IT environment. This integration facilitates automated workflows for asset management, compliance monitoring, and optimization.

* **Comprehensive Asset Management:** By leveraging this API, organizations can achieve enhanced asset management practices, including tracking asset lifecycles, optimizing asset utilization, and ensuring compliance with licensing and security policies.

* **Enhanced Visibility and Control:** Access to detailed asset information through the API enables IT teams to gain better visibility into their asset inventory, make informed decisions, and effectively manage resources across the enterprise.

The Flexera One ITAM Installed Software V1 API generates a report file containing all active devices and their installed software. Report generation is asynchronous, and the output is downloaded as a ZIP file.

There are three steps to get the report:

* **Step 1: Start report generation**  
  Send a POST request (no request body) to:  
  "/fnms/v1/orgs/{orgId}/devices/installed-software"  
  The request initiates report generation and returns a job status of **Created**.

  1. **Poll the generation endpoint**

Async version of the execute endpoint. Starts an asynchronous execution of a saved or built-in ITAM report. The report is executed in the background, and results are partitioned into pages and stored for efficient retrieval. **Benefits and Practical Applications:** * **No Timeouts:** Large reports that would otherwise time out are processed in the background.

Returns a jobId and statusUrl. * **Step 2:** GET {statusUrl} to poll until status is "Completed". * **Step 3:** Use the retrieveUrl from the completed status response to fetch the first page of results. Use the page URL from each response to fetch subsequent pages.

**Available Health Components:**
* **ARL Status** - Application Recognition Library status
* **SKU Library** - SKU Library status  
* **PURL** - Package URL status
* **Data Platform** - Imported software status
* **License Reconciliation** - License reconciliation status
* **Beacon Status** - Beacon connectivity status
* **Inventory Data Inputs** - Data inputs with issues
* **Import Resolver Errors** - Failures processing discovery and inventory uploads
* **Business Adapters** - Business data inputs with issues
* **FNMEA Agent Report Log Rotation** - Engineering Applications agents with report log rotation issues

* **Comprehensive System Monitoring:** Get visibility into all critical system components in one API call
* **Flexible Data Retrieval:** Request specific health components or combine multiple components as needed
* **Integration Support:** Enable automated monitoring and alerting based on system health status
* **Operational Efficiency:** Programmatically access the same health data visible in the UI for reporting and dashboards

* Get all health data: /fnms/v1/orgs/12345/system-health
* Get specific components: /fnms/v1/orgs/12345/system-health?arlStatus&purlStatus&importResolverErrors
* Get single component: /fnms/v1/orgs/12345/system-health?beaconStatus

**Important Notes:**
* **Query Parameters:** Simply including a query parameter in the URL (e.g., ?arlStatus) is sufficient to request that component. No value is required.
* **Timestamps:** All timestamps returned by this API are in UTC format. The FNMS UI may convert these to the operator's local timezone for display.
* **Data Retrieval Status:** Each health component includes a dataRetrievalStatus field. Always check this field before using the component data. The System Tasks API returns the same data that is visible from the System Tasks page in the UI. Users can use query parameters to retrieve specific system tasks.

**Available System Task Fields:**
* **TaskId** - The unique identifier for the system task
* **ParentTaskId** - The identifier for the parent task, if applicable  
* **TaskName** - The name of the system task
* **DateStarted** - The date when the system task started
* **DateCompleted** - The date when the system task completed
* **ConnectionType** - The type of connection used for the system task
* **TaskType** - The type of the system task
* **TaskStatus** - The current status of the system task
* **Summary** - A summary of the system task's execution
* **BeaconUID** - The unique identifier of the beacon associated with the system task
* **BeaconName** - The name of the beacon associated with the system task
* **ServerName** - The name of the server associated with the system task
* **CreatedBy** - The user who created the system task

**Benefits:**
* **Comprehensive System Monitoring:** Get visibility into all system tasks and their statuses
* **Flexible Data Retrieval:** Request specific system tasks as needed
* **Integration Support:** Enable automated monitoring and alerting based on system task status
* **Operational Efficiency:** Programmatically access the same system task data visible in the UI

**Usage Examples:**
* GET /fnms/v1/orgs/1105/system-tasks
* GET /fnms/v1/orgs/1105/system-tasks?days=7
* GET /fnms/v1/orgs/1105/system-tasks?days=7&taskType=businessImport&taskType=inventoryImport
* GET /fnms/v1/orgs/1105/system-tasks?days=30&taskType=businessImport&taskType=inventoryImport&taskStatus=completed&taskStatus=failed
* GET /fnms/v1/orgs/1105/system-tasks?days=30&taskType=businessImport&taskType=inventoryImport&taskStatus=completed&taskStatus=failed&allRuns

**Important Notes:**
* **API Response**: Any field that is null will be excluded from the API response entirely.
* **Query Parameters:** If a value is not provided for days, taskType, or taskStatus, the API will use default values. If allRuns is not included, only the latest run of each system task will be returned. If the task types or statuses are not provided, the tasks will not be filtered on the type or status.
* **Timestamps:** All timestamps returned by this API are in UTC format. The FNMS UI may convert these to the operator's local timezone for display.
* **Parent Tasks:** Tasks that are part of a larger operation will have a ParentTaskId, which will match the TaskId of the parent task. Use this ID to group related tasks together for a comprehensive view of the overall operation.
* **All Runs:** If allRuns is provided in the request, the first occurrence of any given task type in the response is the latest run for that particular task type. All subsequent occurrences are previous executions of that same task type.
* **Beacon Identification:** Tasks with the same name and type that are all the latest run may be provided in the response. The BeaconUID can be used to differentiate between these tasks.
* **Task Status:** Filtering by status applies only to root tasks. As a result, subtasks with different statuses may be included in the response if their parent task matches the specified status filter. Additionally, skipped and scheduled tasks are included under the inProgress filter, rather than in separate filters for their specific statuses.

  2. **Check the generated file endpoint**  
     Use the file path returned in the Step 1 response and send a GET request, for example:  
     "/fnms/v1/orgs/{orgId}/files/{filename}"  
     When the file is ready, the response includes a **Location** header containing the download URL.

  Retrieve the ZIP from the URL provided in the **Location** header. This will typically be a long URL, for example, "https://api.flexera.com/fnmsdata/v1/b0db7056f3b382e9efbdf154f469d407980e98ffc39973dc95730226097e7419.zip".

Flexera One ITAM Installed Software API offers access to comprehensive information regarding all recognized software installed on inventoried devices within a system. In addition to detailing the installed software and common properties of inventoried devices, this API also provides insights into software classification and status.
**Note:** The Installed Software v1 API will no longer be maintained and will be deprecated by the end of the year 2024. We recommend using the Installed Software v2 API, as it provides more value and also offers options to request data in JSON or CSV format.

**Benefits and Practical Applications:** * **Comprehensive Inventory Management:** Enables organizations to maintain an accurate inventory of software assets across all devices, facilitating compliance and license management. * **Risk Mitigation:** Identifies outdated or vulnerable software versions that may pose security risks, allowing for timely updates and patches. * **Cost Optimization:** Helps in optimizing software usage and licenses by identifying unused or underutilized applications. * **IT Asset Management:** Supports IT departments in effectively managing and optimizing their software assets throughout their lifecycle. * **Security and Compliance:** Facilitates compliance with software licensing agreements and regulatory requirements by providing accurate software inventory data. * **Operational Efficiency:** Automates inventory processes and reduces manual effort in maintaining and updating software records. * **Export File Availability (1 hour):** The generated export file is available for download for 1 hour after it is created; after that you must request a new export.
